A bill for an act relating to education finance; appropriating money for a grant to the Kids In Need Foundation.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Department of Education.+]

[+The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal year designated. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Kids In Need Foundation.+]

[+(a) For a grant to the Kids In Need Foundation for programs and activities that decrease absenteeism, encourage school engagement and interest in learning, improve student grades, and improve student graduation rates: +]

[+$ +]

[+3,000,000 +]

[+..... +]

[+2026 +]

[+(b) The grant must be used to support Minnesota schools in which at least half of enrolled students qualify for free or reduced-price meals, with a focus on low-income students and students of color. Eligible uses of the grant include: +]

[+(1) providing educational supplies to support the Kids In Need Foundation Rural and Indigenous School Equity program; +]

[+(2) increasing access to the Kids In Need Foundation Teacher Resource Center and training facility; +]

[+(3) enhancing volunteer space; and +]

[+(4) supporting additional supply distributions to teachers and students. +]

[+(c) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, up to ... percent of the appropriation is available for grant administration. +]

[+(d) This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; appropriating money for a grant to the Kids In Need Foundation.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal year designated.

Subd. 2.

Kids In Need Foundation.

(a) For a grant to the Kids In Need Foundation for programs and activities that decrease absenteeism, encourage school engagement and interest in learning, improve student grades, and improve student graduation rates:

$

3,000,000

.....

2026

(b) The grant must be used to support Minnesota schools in which at least half of enrolled students qualify for free or reduced-price meals, with a focus on low-income students and students of color. Eligible uses of the grant include:

(1) providing educational supplies to support the Kids In Need Foundation Rural and Indigenous School Equity program;

(2) increasing access to the Kids In Need Foundation Teacher Resource Center and training facility;

(3) enhancing volunteer space; and

(4) supporting additional supply distributions to teachers and students.

(c) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, up to ... percent of the appropriation is available for grant administration.

(d) This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: APPROPRIATIONS.
Subdivision 1.
Department of Education.
The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal year designated.
Subd. 2.
Kids In Need Foundation.

(a) For a grant to the Kids In Need Foundation for programs and activities that decrease absenteeism, encourage school engagement and interest in learning, improve student grades, and improve student graduation rates:

(b) The grant must be used to support Minnesota schools in which at least half of enrolled students qualify for free or reduced-price meals, with a focus on low-income students and students of color. Eligible uses of the grant include:
(1) providing educational supplies to support the Kids In Need Foundation Rural and Indigenous School Equity program;
(2) increasing access to the Kids In Need Foundation Teacher Resource Center and training facility;
(3) enhancing volunteer space; and
(4) supporting additional supply distributions to teachers and students.
(c) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, up to ... percent of the appropriation is available for grant administration.
(d) This is a onetime appropriation.
